assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated item, reviewed-dedicated-analysis: the canonical V2 character reconstruction model MHA_SP2_TOKOYAMI_FUMIKAGE_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its TF-SUP-01 to TF-SUP-03 sections admit. The MHA character modeling schema was consulted for method only; the readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit and the deep readings are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's strong label and its retrospective holdout probe are inputs, not conclusions. Older V27 analysis compressing the Hawks extraction is excluded, as the model's chronology correction requires. No original manga page, anime adaptation, V1 material or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Tokoyami from the V08 Ectoplasm exam and V09:p160-176 loss of control of Dark Shadow, through the V21:p169-181 development of Black Fallen Angel from Hawks's recognition, the V27:p179 arrival and V28:p060-077 rescue of Hawks under Dabi's accusation, the V36:p073-092 coalition role beside Endeavor, Hawks and Jiro (logical pages), and the V38:p099-113 environmentally enabled large action, to the V42:p162-175 adult professional and cohort continuity. assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states recurring priorities (useful heroic action, mastery and regulation of his particular capacity, earned recognition, loyalty to those who helped him develop), an ideal of a capable and composed self with a distinctive expressive identity and a feared state of power escaping direction, grounded in TF01-TF04; the probe TF-V01 rates motive supported. The model marks the feared state as inference and warns against reading his dark aesthetic as morbidity. Not B: one compact artifact, one retrospective nonblind probe, and private adult breadth is OPEN. Not D: the policy is operational and conditioned on control state, mentor danger and role.

Located transitions separate the early student whose Dark Shadow exceeds control (TF01), the intern who authors a mobility technique from Hawks's recognition (TF02), the rescuer who returns for that mentor (TF03), the coalition student who accepts a bounded role (TF04-TF05) and the adult hero (TF06); TF-SUP-03 adds trained darkness control as situated capability. The model's chronology correction moves the completed extraction from V27 to V28. Not B: long intervals are unsampled and the adult state rests on one sequence plus supplements. Not D: change is located, including a reciprocal reversal of the mentor relation.

The model identifies 俺, formal or archaizing metaphorical diction and carefully named dark techniques, locates two load-bearing words (師 at V28:p066 and 信じてる at p077), notes the shift to forceful direct speech under acute danger, requires Dark Shadow's delivery to be attributed separately, and warns against grand darkness language in every mundane reply; the probe rates speech/register supported. Not C: two located words are not quoted lines, and ordinary and adult register are little sampled. Not E: a register, its variants and located markers are identified. The discovery row does not enroll SPEECH.

The one located ordinary window is TF06, joining professional and ordinary cohort life at V42; the bedtime negotiation with Dark Shadow is an author comment, and the choker and the guitar given up at the F chord are editorial summary, self-report and gag (TF-SUP-01 to TF-SUP-02). The model says ordinary samples are narrower than battlefield evidence. Not D: no enacted ordinary routine is analyzed beyond one late sequence.

A five-row partner table gives conditional behavior toward Hawks, Dark Shadow, Tsuyu and Shoji, Jiro and the Endeavor coalition, and Dabi, with a located delta for Hawks across TF02, TF03 and TF05: recognition received, then reciprocal rescue of the recognizer, then coalition action, with trust kept epistemically bounded. The probe rates relationship handling supported. Not B: adult and private human relations are thinly sampled. Not D: one partner is tracked through located states and others have located conditioned conduct.

Located interior states are urgency, alarm and anger under the mentor's lethal danger and voiced trust without full knowledge (TF03); the feared state of power escaping direction is the model's inference from crisis and regulation. The probe rates emotional trajectory partial. Not C: his interior is inferred mainly from conduct and a few utterances, and no self-disclosure window is analyzed. Not E: located affective states and their effect on choice are described.

The decision policy is explicit: identify the function he can perform, coordinate it with capacities he cannot replace, follow tactical instruction under urgency, and expect control and output to vary with darkness, stress and allies. It is located repeatedly in TF01 and TF03-TF05, and the probe rates action supported conditionally, with external success unpredicted. Not B: one probe and a combat-and-rescue sample; ordinary private conflict is unsampled. Not D: the policy is explicit, repeated and conditioned on stated variables.

One located choice weighs competing considerations: in TF03 (directly checked) he prioritizes his mentor's immediate life over Dabi's accusation, which he cannot adjudicate, and voices belief rather than knowledge; the model analyzes this as a narrower judgment than proving every act justified. Not C: one dilemma, and his reasoning is inferred from the rescue and one utterance. Not E: the choice and its knowledge limits are located and analyzed. The discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.
The model analyzes no humor practice; his dark aesthetic is described as chosen style, and the guitar admission is a supplement gag (TF-SUP-01). This gap says nothing about the character.

The project's analytical corpus is complete for V01-V42 and the admitted supplements; six atoms span V08-V42 with page locators, the V28 and V36 atoms are directly checked, and the V36 logical-page mapping is stated. Long intervals are unsampled, the adult state is one sequence, and the supplements are editorial summaries, profile facts, a self-report, a gag and an author comment.

Affirmative limits are located: the model REJECTs the V27 completed extraction, replacing every stronger ally and epistemic certainty from trust (TF03-TF04), says no equivalent capacity should be inferred in bright isolated conditions, denies the analyst access to unspoken shared thoughts with Dark Shadow, treats trained darkness control as situated rather than immunity (TF-SUP-03), and says dramatic names do not imply eloquence or competence in every cool-looking activity (TF-SUP-01). Not B: the limits rest on few windows in one artifact.

Atoms are page-located, the V27/V28 chronology correction is explicit, the V36 logical-page convention is stated, two atoms are directly checked, and the frozen probe ends at V26 and excludes both compressed passages. Not B: long intervals are unsampled and in-world dates are not given.

scenario_readiness.note: The model quotes two located words, not lines, and states that generated dialogue would be an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation; ordinary register is little sampled and Dark Shadow's speech must be attributed separately. Lines beyond the described register would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Tokoyami's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state, stated explicitly: early student, interning student, rescuer at V28, coalition student or adult hero at V42; acquired mobility and trained control are not given to earlier states.
Lighting, wind, injury, carried load and Dark Shadow's control state are specified; output varies with them and no capacity is inferred in bright isolated conditions.

The interlocutor is Hawks, Dark Shadow, Tsuyu, Shoji, Jiro, the Endeavor coalition or Dabi, handled as the partner table gives; Dark Shadow is a separate speaker and no invented private or romantic relationship is used.
Output is a behavioral description with alternatives; he is not given the reader's knowledge, no quoted dialogue is produced as canon and no readiness is inherited from the strong label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: early student, intern, V28 rescuer, coalition student or adult hero, stated explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Hawks, Dark Shadow, Tsuyu, Shoji, Jiro, the Endeavor coalition or Dabi, in the relation the partner table gives for that state.
setting_constraints: Exam, internship, rescue or coalition hero operation
Darkness and light, environmental and knowledge limits respected
No adult private, family or romantic setting

scenario_readiness.note: The model's stated hypothetical (late-school Tokoyami assigned a bounded aerial rescue role beside a stronger attacker: precise cooperation rather than status resentment, high confidence in that domain; uncontrolled darkness, serious injury or an endangered Hawks change priority) and the probe's conditionally supported mentor rescue support narrow novel scenes. The probe is retrospective, nonblind and partial on emotional trajectory.
One located late cohort sequence and supplement texture do not support ordinary social simulation; the model gives low confidence to romance, family conflict and independent adult home routines.
One located dilemma (TF03, mentor's life against an unadjudicated accusation) supports canon questions about that scene, not generation of new moral deliberation.
The model says intimate adult relations remain insufficient; the evidence set establishes neither romantic conduct nor its absence. That limits inference; it says nothing about the character.

conditions: The setting is an internship under Hawks, a supervised or coalition hero operation, or adult hero work, with the state stated.
Output preserves accurate self-limitation beside stronger allies, coordination with others' capacities, mentor-specific loyalty and dependence of maximum output on environment and allies.
Detailed adult agency work beyond TF06 is not predicted; assisting licensing examinations at Hawks's request is a supplement profile fact that constrains without becoming enacted conduct.
scenario_readiness.note: Professional conduct is located in the internship (TF02), the rescue (TF03, directly checked), the coalition operations (TF04-TF05, TF04 directly checked) and the adult continuity (TF06).

known_limits.statement: He rescues Hawks before complete adjudication and voices belief, not knowledge; he does not have the full Hawks and Twice exchange and must not be given the reader's evidence (TF03).
V27:p179 depicts only arrival; the accusation, reply and completed extraction belong to V28:p060-077, and compressed V27 accounts are excluded.
Darkness amplifies and light constrains Dark Shadow; maximum action depends on darkness, wind and allies (TF05), and no equivalent capacity follows in bright isolated conditions.
Dark Shadow's power magnitude and his control are distinct; under overwhelming darkness or stress they can diverge (TF01), and trained control is situated, not immunity (TF-SUP-03).
Dark Shadow is an embodied companion with changing autonomy and a distinct delivery; its utterances and actions are not automatically his, and the analyst has no access to unspoken shared thoughts.
He recognizes roles he cannot replace and follows openings beside stronger allies; replacing every stronger ally is REJECTed (TF04).
His dark imagery and dramatic names are chosen style, not evidence of morbidity, hostility, universal eloquence or competence in every activity (TF-SUP-01).
Supplement editorial summaries, profile facts, the self-report, the gag and the author comment (TF-SUP-01 to TF-SUP-03) constrain reconstruction without becoming enacted manga observations.

The single formal probe TF-V01 is a retrospective chronological evidence holdout by an analyst who had read later manga, not a blind experiment; emotional trajectory was partial and external escape conditions unpredicted.
Private adult breadth and independent private-human relationships are OPEN or a specialist gap in the model.
No atom covers V01-V07, V10-V20, V22-V26, V29-V35 or V39-V41, so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.

The deep readings, readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not independently rechecked here. Anime performance and any supplement material beyond what the model cites lie outside this evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
